items.idea: GTA VI Reviews Are In - And the Scores Are Shocking
items.notes: Cover the first GTA VI critic reviews and explain why the scores are historically high. As of November 18, 2026, review roundups report a 99 Metacritic score and 98 OpenCritic score, with several perfect ratings. Discuss what reviewers praise—Vice City’s detail, open-world freedom, characters, story, NPC behavior, technical ambition, and Rockstar’s polish—while also covering recurring criticisms. Compare the reception with GTA V and other historically acclaimed games. Verify all scores and review counts immediately before writing because they may change as additional reviews appear. Avoid story spoilers and do not invent quotations.
